description.narrative:
At the Project level, the Project is expected to create direct jobs and improve local businesses access to high-quality and modern urban infrastructure. In addition, it is expected to improve energy and water use efficiency by deploying energy-friendly, EDGE-certified infrastructure, thereby reducing the Projects GHG emissions.
Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that the investment will improve quality standards in the Vinh Phucs accommodation sector. Through competitive pressure, existing players are expected improve their service standards, product quality, and safety and hygiene measures.

The proposed IFC investment consists of subscriptions to sustainability-linked bonds (SLB) of up to approximately US$150 million (in VND equivalent), of which US$50 million will be issued by Thanh Xuan Joint Stock Company and US$100 million will be issued by BIM Land Joint Stock Company (BIM Land). The proposed IFC investment is earmarked for (i) the development of Thanh Xuan valley project, which includes a hotel complex under the InterContinental brand, shophouses, and infrastructure of the project; and (ii) InterContinental Hotel and Regent Hotel in Phu Quoc.
